# Novel NSFW Tagger Skill

## What this project is
Novel NSFW Tagger Skill is a pure-algorithm content tagging tool for Chinese web novels.
It detects potentially explicit sections and writes inline markers and chapter-level tags.

## Primary use cases
- Scan Chinese novel text for NSFW passages
- Add chapter title annotations like `(nsfw 63)`
- Insert `<nsfw_start/>` and `<nsfw_end/>` markers
- Generate audit artifacts for review

## Core algorithm
- Tiered lexicon with L0/L1/L2 keywords
- Paragraph-level co-occurrence scoring
- L2 terms only count when L0/L1 appears in same paragraph
- Chapter NSFW ratio computed from first hot paragraph to last hot paragraph
- Chapter considered NSFW when ratio >= 5

## Entry points
- Tagging script: `skills/novel-nsfw-tagger/scripts/tag.py`
- Validation script: `skills/novel-nsfw-tagger/scripts/validate.py`
- Skill spec: `skills/novel-nsfw-tagger/SKILL.md`
- Lexicon config: `skills/novel-nsfw-tagger/config/lexicon.json`

## Input/output
- Inputs: `.txt` (UTF-8/UTF-16/GBK), `.epub` (requires optional deps)
- Output workdir: `.novel-nsfw/<novel_name>/`
- Main artifacts:
  - `work.json`
  - `<novel_name>_tagged.txt`

## Safety and limitations
- Heuristic keyword method; false positives and false negatives are possible
- Human review is required for moderation or policy decisions
- Do not use for illegal content or minor-involved material
- See `DISCLAIMER.md` for full terms
